findings: HPSS validates the separated-source transport and metadata path but is not an instrument separator.
The harmonic stream increased onset count and spectral pitch hypotheses relative to the mixture, demonstrating that detector counts are separator-dependent.
The percussive stream increased detected percussive onsets and high-frequency token counts, so raw event counts must remain provenance-bound.
HPSS cannot resolve Bass versus Piano-LH ownership; a learned multi-stem separator or instrument-specific attribution model is still required.
